core_obligations: Show OR composition creates exponentially many nonzero Fourier monomials from a maximum-degree monomial.
Relate degree, XOR communication rank and parity decision-tree simulation, then close the log-rank upper bound.
difficulty_reason: The authors track maximum-degree monomials under OR composition to force Fourier sparsity, link that sparsity to XOR communication rank and combine decision-tree and parity-query simulations to establish a nontrivial log-rank subclass.

dedup.scope: Actual journal DOI and CCC/ECCC aliases absent in complete existing snapshots and root active-line checks. Independent log-rank result for f composed with OR and XOR, not a support lemma for depth-to-size or conjunction-DAG classifications.

compared.difference: Communication log-rank subclass versus decision-tree gadget classification.
Spectral/communication theorem versus conjunction-DAG certificate lifting.
